system.longDesc:
Source: Technology. Cost: 1 EN.

One of your arms is replaced with a cybernetic prosthetic as effective as a real lim, which also gives you a x2 Force Multiplier for Strength tests and actions related solely to your arm and hand. More advanced Cybernetic Arms might have a higher Force Multiplier (for more enhancements) or one or more built-in Innate Attacks, such as a concealed gun or blade.
